title: 4.0.0.0-dev Dexcom CGM granting permission
symptom: A popup appears asking to grant permission for reading CGM. Clicking 'Grant' appears to do nothing, but functionality is fully given (CGM values received and closed looping works). The popup opens regularly, which is annoying.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause. A maintainer suggests it may be related to the user's Android version and notes that BYODA might not be installed, but the user disagrees and confirms BYODA is installed.
fix: The maintainer suggests granting permission from Android settings: Apps - AAPS - Permissions. No other resolution is provided.
evidence_quote: It's probably related to your Android. You can still do it from Android settings - Apps - AAPS - Permisssions
